speech_not_understood.hi-IN: Maaf kijiye, samajh nahi aaya. Kripya dobara bataiye.
speech_not_understood.en-IN: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you please repeat?
speech_not_understood.ta-IN: Mannikkavum, puriyavillai. Thayavu seidhu meendum sollungal.
speech_not_understood.te-IN: Kshaminchandi, artham kaledu. Dayachesi malli cheppandi.
speech_not_understood.bn-IN: Khoma korben, bujhte parini. Doya kore abar bolun.
speech_not_understood.mr-IN: Kshamasva, samajle nahi. Krupaya punha sanga.

service_unavailable.hi-IN: Abhi ye service available nahi hai. Kripya thodi der baad try karein.
service_unavailable.en-IN: This service is currently unavailable. Please try again shortly.
service_unavailable.ta-IN: Indha sevai ippodhu kidaikkavillai. Siridhu neram kazhithu muyarchikkavum.
service_unavailable.te-IN: Ee seva prastutam andubatulo ledu. Konchem sepu tarvatah malli prayatninchandi.
service_unavailable.bn-IN: Ei sheba ekhon pawa jachche na. Kichukhon por abar chesta korun.
service_unavailable.mr-IN: Hi seva sadhya uplabdh nahi. Krupaya thodya velane punha prayatna kara.

otp_sent.hi-IN: Aapke phone par OTP bheja gaya hai. Kripya OTP bataiye.
otp_sent.en-IN: An OTP has been sent to your phone. Please tell me the OTP.
otp_sent.ta-IN: Ungal tholaipesikku OTP anuppappattullathu. Thayavu seidhu OTP ai sollungal.
otp_sent.te-IN: Mi phonela OTP pampabidindhi. Dayachesi OTP cheppandi.
otp_sent.bn-IN: Apnar phone a OTP pathano hoyeche. Doya kore OTP bolun.
otp_sent.mr-IN: Tumchya phone var OTP pathavla aahe. Krupaya OTP sanga.

otp_wrong.hi-IN: Ye OTP galat hai. Kripya dobara bataiye.
otp_wrong.en-IN: That OTP is incorrect. Please try again.
otp_wrong.ta-IN: Andha OTP thavarana. Thayavu seidhu meendum muyarchikkavum.
otp_wrong.te-IN: Aa OTP tappu. Dayachesi malli prayatninchandi.
otp_wrong.bn-IN: Oi OTP ti bhul. Doya kore abar chesta korun.
otp_wrong.mr-IN: Te OTP chukiche aahe. Krupaya punha prayatna kara.

otp_expired.hi-IN: OTP expire ho gaya hai. Kya naya OTP bhejein?
otp_expired.en-IN: Your OTP has expired. Shall I send a new one?
otp_expired.ta-IN: Ungal OTP kaalavadhi aagi vittathu. Pudhiya OTP ai anuppattuma?
otp_expired.te-IN: Mi OTP expire ayindi. Nenu kotha OTP pampamantara?
otp_expired.bn-IN: Apnar OTP meyad uttirno hoyeche. Ami ki notun OTP pathabo?
otp_expired.mr-IN: Tumche OTP expire zale aahe. Navin OTP pathavu ka?

otp_max_attempts.hi-IN: Bahut zyada galat attempts ho gaye. Kripya baad mein call karein.
otp_max_attempts.en-IN: Too many incorrect attempts. Please call back later.
otp_max_attempts.te-IN: Chala tappu prayatnalu. Tarvatah call cheyandi.
otp_max_attempts.bn-IN: Anek bhul chesta. Pore call korun.
otp_max_attempts.mr-IN: Khuup chukiche prayatna zale. Krupaya nantar call kara.

general_error.hi-IN: Kuch gadbad ho gayi. Kripya thodi der baad dobara call karein.
general_error.en-IN: Something went wrong. Please call back in a few minutes.
general_error.ta-IN: Etho thavaru nadanthathu. Siridhu neram kazhithu meendum azhaikkavum.
general_error.te-IN: Edo tappu jarigindi. Konchem sepu tarvatah malli call cheyandi.
general_error.bn-IN: Kichu shomossha hoyeche. Kichukhon por abar call korun.
general_error.mr-IN: Kahi tari chukle aahe. Krupaya thodya velane punha call kara.

timeout.hi-IN: Lagta hai aap busy hain. Aap kisi bhi samay dobara call kar sakte hain. Dhanyavaad!
timeout.en-IN: It seems you're busy. You can call back anytime. Thank you!
timeout.ta-IN: Neengal busy aga irukkeergal ena thondrugirathu. Neengal eppodhu vendumanalum meendum azhaikkalam. Nandri!
timeout.te-IN: Miru busy ga unnatlu undi. Miru eppudaina malli call cheyavochu. Dhanyavadalu!
timeout.bn-IN: Mone hochche apni basto achen. Apni jekono shomoy abar call korte paren. Dhonnobad!
timeout.mr-IN: Asa distay ki tumhi vyast aahat. Tumhi kadhihi punha call karu shakta. Dhanyavad!
